description: IMAGE-PREWARM-A (docs/operations/aws.md 22.9): the image digest (or content tag) of the live runner. A runner process whose TOWER_IMAGE_DIGEST is set and differs from a non-empty pointer stands by: healthy, but it takes no work (no run is claimed; a runner that was live finishes its runs in flight and exits). Empty (the default) is no pointer: every process works, as before. A write notifies tower_config (migration 0010), so the swap is seen at once; the standby that turns live records platform.deploy.image_live {role, digest, swap_s}.
